thread:
maria: Quick sync 1 1 Need final landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private that matches launch posts + webinar narrative. Copy freeze Mon EOD. Who owns hero + CTA mapping + forms?

alex: I got hero + CTA. Will draft three tight hero variants with subcopy + target URLs by tomorrow AM.

sam: I'll build the webinar benchmark slide + two one-paragraph customer vignettes. Can someone export p50 token latency, tokens/sec and a cost delta for caching/quant? @alex?

jordan: Routing idea: distinct funnels and forms - trial (lightweight), capacity (sales intake), private (enterprise intake + compliance). Add hidden fields `product_mode` and `campaign_source` for attribution.

kevin: Hero seed lines (pick one family, then tune per mode):
- Performance: `Build with predictable, low-latency LLM inference`
- Economics: `Lower inference cost without sacrificing quality`
- Reliability: `Production-grade inference with SLA and fallbacks`
We should keep the hero family unified and change subcopy per mode.

maria: Perfect. We need: final hero, 1 supporting paragraph, 3 bullets (tech diffs), CTA mapping, microcopy for the top form (privacy + expected response time). Keep it brief and developer-forward.

alex: First-pass copy (feel free to edit):
- Hosted hero: `Instant API to ship LLM features`
  Hosted sub: "SDKs, streaming responses, and predictable per-token pricing—get started in minutes."
  CTA: `Start building` -> /signup?utm=launch_hosted
- Dedicated hero: `Reserved GPUs for predictable throughput`
  Dedicated sub: "SLA-backed capacity, configurable autoscaling, and throughput guarantees for production."
  CTA: `Request capacity quote` -> /sales/dedicated?utm=launch_dedicated
- Private hero: `Bring inference into your VPC or on-prem`
  Private sub: "KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, and compliance-ready deployments."
  CTA: `Schedule consult` -> /enterprise/contact?utm=launch_private

sam: Benchmark blurb (for webinar): "Across representative workloads (chat and assistant-style prompts), median token latency was ~28ms on modern GPU instances; batching + KV cache increased aggregate throughput ~2.5x. Customers adopting caching + quantized variants saw ~38% reduction in inference spend while preserving output quality in evals."
Two mini-cases: "Nimbus: cut 95th-tail latency by 30% after cache tuning." "ByteCart: lowered per-request cost 35% by switching to bfloat16 variants + batching." I'll attach two slides with numbers.

jordan: Proposed form fields / routing: 
- Trial (lightweight): `email`, `company` (optional), `use_case` (dropdown). Auto-provision trial, route to onboard flow.
- Dedicated (sales): `company`, `expected_rps`, `preferred_region`, `contact_phone`. Routes to SDR queue A; form triggers calendar link for qualification.
- Private (enterprise): `company`, `security_contact`, `compliance_needs`, `nda_needed` (checkbox). Routes to AE + legal.
Add hidden fields: `product_mode=hosted|dedicated|private`, `campaign_source`, `utm_content`.

kevin: A/B plan: cohorts = `webinar_attendees`, `organic_search`, `paid_social`. Test 3 hero variants (performance / economics / reliability) across cohorts for 14 days. Primary metric = trial start rate; secondary = MQL (sales-qualified) for Dedicated/Private.

maria: Analytics events to instrument: `hero_impression`, `cta_click`, `form_submit`, `trial_provisioned`. Also track `product_mode` in all events. Microcopy for top-of-funnel: "We respect your privacy. We won't share your info. Trial access in <24h."

alex: I'll produce an annotated mockup (Figma link) + copy doc with event names and UTM schema by 10:30AM tomorrow.

ops-bot: Event created: "Landing copy review + webinar alignment" Tue 14:00 UTC. Attendees: maria, alex, sam, jordan, kevin. Link: https://cal.example.com/6187654321

maria: Thanks everyone. Bring assets to the 2pm review: sam (slides), jordan (form schema + routing matrix), alex (mockups + copy), kevin (A/B cohort plan). :thumbsup:
